content:
tim: Quick check — anyone up for a 15-min 'cozy cocoa' hangout Friday? Low-key, holiday tunes, cookie show-and-tell. :hot_cocoa:

alexa: In! Can I bring my cat on camera? :cat_with_wry_smile:

josie: Yes to cookies. Also can we have a 2-slide holiday gif showcase? :sparkles:

marco: I can DJ 3 songs. Will keep it chill. :headphones:

people-ops-beth: People-ops can ship a mini cookie kit to remote folks if you RSVP by Thu EOD. RSVP form: https://forms.example.com/cozy-cocoa

tim: Awesome. Ill post a calendar invite. Poll: 10:00 PST or 16:00 CET? React with :one: for PST, :two: for CET.

alexa: :two: works better for me.

josie: :one: but flexible.

marco: :two: — Ill queue up a winter acoustic set.

people-ops-beth: Shipping note: if you prefer a vegan cookie kit, tick the dietary box in the form.

tim: Sweet. See you Friday, cookies and cats encouraged. :evergreen_tree:
